questions.prompt: What does Zura Spa seek to achieve through its services?
What qualities are expected of someone representing Zura Spa?
How does my individual behaviour influence the experience of our clients?
What responsibilities do I have towards my colleagues and management?
Which expectations do I already meet consistently, and where do I need to improve?

title: MY PERSONAL JOURNEY — YESTERDAY, TODAY, AND THE PERSON I AM BECOMING

questions.prompt: Part A: The Person I Was. Describe yourself when you first joined Zura Spa. Consider your expectations, motivation, attitude, strengths, dreams, and goals.
Part B: The Person I Have Become. Describe yourself today, including positive changes, skills gained, and areas needing improvement.
Part C: The Person I Want to Become. Describe the version of yourself you would like to see in the next six months, and identify at least three specific habits you will begin developing.
What would I take more seriously?
What attitudes would I approach differently?
What mistakes would I make a conscious effort to avoid?
How would I build better relationships with colleagues?
How would I respond when corrected or misunderstood?
What would I do to become a more dependable and valuable therapist?
Final reflection (write at least 150 words): If I had the opportunity to begin again, what would I do differently, and what is stopping me from beginning those changes today?
Let go of one limiting belief. Identify one negative belief about yourself or your ability to improve, then replace it with a realistic, encouraging statement.
Identify one behaviour to improve. Choose one specific behaviour you would like to change and describe what a better response would look like.
Make one commitment to yourself. Write down one practical action you will begin taking immediately, whether or not anyone is watching.
